properties.displayName: OT - Telemetry Silence from Known Log Source
properties.description: A device that reported CEF/syslog telemetry in the prior 24h has gone silent for 2+ hours while the forwarder heartbeat is still healthy. In a unidirectional (data diode) architecture there is no inbound path to probe the source — silence IS the alarm. Common causes: TAP failure, sensor down, diode transmit fault, source-side config change. Complements the forwarder heartbeat-loss rule, which only catches whole-pipeline failure.
